notes.title: Second update patch
notes.content:
Attention Participants! Your safety in our laboratory continues to be a top priority for us. Although we cannot legally guarantee your safety, it is important to our research that you feel you can count on us.  We continue to improve the experience, but there was one issue that we could not figure. It was huge mystery and everyone began to talk. Rumors began to fly around about some cursed bunny ears but we fixed the malfunction. No superstitions here! 

[u]Updates to the facilities[/u]
-Change Indicators for Skateboard minigames to rings
-Improve camera on skateboard
-Fixed duplicate cars spawning
-Fixed areas where rocketpack can exit level
-Add more NPCs to some areas
-Improve forklift driving experience
-Forklift level lighting optimization
-Lawnmower Lighting optimization
-Achievements now show up on Steam
-Improve dialog for some NPCs
-Fix toys not showing up in inventory
-No more bunny ears....Hopefully!

I know it looks like a lot of updates but this is a huge laboratory and then you have the outside. Oh wait! Forget I said that!

notes.title: First Patch Update
notes.content:
Greetings Participants!  Your safety in our laboratory is of the utmost importance to us. In order to make your experience more enjoyable and accommodating, we are updating our facilities to address the following issues.

-	Fixed bug that prevents some clients from saving progress.
-	Fixed bug where Secret Keys appear as bunny ears (yep, this was a real bug.)
-	Fixed some character dialog issues.
-	Fixed bug where item pickups didn’t reappear.

We hope you continue to have a safe and happy experience as we gather valuable data from your tribulations!
